results.problem: Maximum Weight Acyclic Subgraph Above MaxST (MAS/MaxST) with integer weights
results.quote: Theorem 1. MAS/MaxST(\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 1}) admits an algorithm with 2^{k^{\mathcal{O}(1)}}\cdot|\mathcal{I}|^{\mathcal{O}(1)} running time.

results.problem: Maximum Weight Acyclic Subgraph Above MaxST (MAS/MaxST) with rational weights not less than 1
results.quote: Theorem 2. MAS/MaxST(\mathbb{Q}_{\ge 1}) admits an algorithm with n^{k^{\mathcal{O}(1)}}\cdot|\mathcal{I}|^{\mathcal{O}(1)} running time.
